infrastructure.reason.no_meter_class_con.description: the selection is unresolved or no word position of the row is documented, so the value is Unknown, never zero

infrastructure.reason.answered_not_decod.description: a group answered, but no word of it is decoded; an answer is neither a value nor an identity

infrastructure.reason.read_exception_no_.description: an exception on a meter read negates neither the gateway nor an identified inverter and publishes no meter value

infrastructure.reason.refused_on_family.description: the inverter-exposed meter group was refused with an exception on the M3 series; its behavior at other children is Unknown

infrastructure.reason.profile_withholds_.description: the admitted SUN2000 profiles decode no meter word and withhold every meter

infrastructure.reason.identity_not_read.description: the identity read of the declared meter was not supplied, so its value is withheld and the declaration is neither confirmed nor replaced

infrastructure.reason.identity_mismatch.description: the identity read, or the routed unit that supplied the reading, differs from the declaration from the documented listing; the mismatch is reported, never guessed, and the read meter never replaces the declared one

infrastructure.reason.role_not_declared.description: the role of the meter is not declared as the role of this row, and a role is never derived, so the role-dependent fact is not published

infrastructure.reason.opposite_direction.description: the reading carries the other direction in this observation, so this item has no value and is Unknown, never zero

infrastructure.reason.value_outside_pack.description: the converted value lies outside the bounds of the pack element, so it is withheld and never clamped

infrastructure.reason.group_not_read.description: the plant group was not read at its own routed unit or the read failed, so its value is Unknown, never zero
